usedFor: MarketProvider holds your product catalog, and Asana tracks the work when “New Product Created” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product Created” in MarketProvider, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets its own task, so launch steps start without anyone remembering to add them.

watchOut: “Product Is Updated” also triggers, so a product edited twice can create a second task.
